description: This Java class handles the submission of fixed deposit account application commands. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and is annotated with @CommandType for 'FIXEDDEPOSITACCOUNT' creation actions. It delegates the processing of the command to the DepositApplicationProcessWritePlatformService's submitFDApplication method.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountApplicationSubmittalCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the submission of fixed deposit account application commands by delegating to the deposit account write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command by calling submitFDApplication on the deposit account write platform service.
